providers.name: Stotles

pricing.plansText: Sales Studio Free: £0. Sales Studio Basic: from £99/month. Sales Studio Growth: from £475/month. Bid Studio Basic: £0. Bid Studio Growth: from £495/month. B2G Growth Engine: from £873/month. Expert tiers are custom.
pricing.seatDetail: The reviewed pricing page uses a mixture of plan and user allowances. Confirm included users, additional seats and whether each displayed figure is per user or per workspace in the order form.
pricing.vatDetail: VAT treatment is not stated beside the reviewed headline prices.
pricing.trialDetail: Free plans are published. Trial terms for paid tiers are not consistently stated on the reviewed pricing page.

comparablePlans.notes: Displayed as from £99/month. The same live page also contains older £50 and £75 references.
Connected Sales Studio and Bid Studio package, displayed as from £873/month.

semanticAiMatching.detail: Sales Studio scores and explains tender relevance against company context and signal settings, with saved searches and alerts.

buyerProfiles.detail: Stotles publishes cross-notice buyer profiles combining opportunities, awards, contacts, contracts and intent documents for named authorities.

supplierProfiles.detail: The data product joins suppliers, awards and buyer relationships and supports competitor and supplier analysis across notices.

renewalSignals.detail: The platform publishes more than 100,000 expiring-contract records and exposes expiry views with source contract context.

similarContracts.detail: Users can inspect prior awards, incumbents, values and comparable buyer activity when qualifying an opportunity.

buyerDocuments.detail: Stotles documents a searchable corpus of more than 400,000 buyer-intent documents, including budgets, board minutes, strategies and policy documents, with relevant passages surfaced for upcoming work.

buyerRequirements.detail: Tender documents, summaries and qualification context are available, but the reviewed pages do not establish a complete reusable cross-tender requirements layer for each buyer.

requirementsPlanning.detail: Bid Studio supports qualification, projects and answer-library workflows, but a durable pre-tender readiness record joining requirement gaps, evidence, owners and dates was not fully established.

awardHistory.detail: Stotles publishes more than 375,000 awards with buyer, supplier, value and relationship context.

frameworks.detail: The platform includes frameworks and call-offs in its connected public-procurement data.

competitorTracking.detail: Supplier and award intelligence supports competitor, incumbent and buyer-relationship tracking.

exportsApi.detail: Growth and Expert packages advertise CRM integrations and data delivery options, with availability varying by plan.

collaboration.detail: Paid team plans support shared searches, pipelines and connected sales and bid workflows.

bidWriting.detail: Bid Studio provides tender-document analysis, qualification and AI-assisted bid-response workflow on current plans.

otherCoverageClaims.claim: Stotles says it connects data from more than 100 portals and refreshes signals daily.

deepAudit.researchSummary: Stotles is a connected UK public-sector sales and bid platform with unusually broad buyer-intent document coverage, resolved buyer and supplier context, awards, expiries and workflow. Public plan architecture is visible, but the live pricing page contains conflicting entry-price copy and many advanced limits require an order form.

legalAndMaturity.detail: The current terms identify Stotle Ltd, company number 10912358, and set the legal basis for the subscription service.

targetCustomerAndUseCase.detail: Separate Sales Studio and Bid Studio products target public-sector sales, account planning, tender qualification and response production, with a connected B2G package.

dataSourcesAndCoverageMethod.detail: The provider names the national UK portals, TED and Digital Marketplace and describes a wider 100-plus-portal data layer spanning tenders, awards, frameworks, contracts and buyer documents.

dataIngestionAndFreshness.detail: Daily signal refresh is stated, but per-source latency, amendment reconciliation, failed-ingestion monitoring and historical backfill controls are not publicly quantified.

matchingAndQualificationMethod.detail: AI signal scores, company context, saved searches and explanations are documented. Public precision, recall, calibration and model-change evaluation are not.

buyerEntityInvestment.detail: Buyer profiles connect opportunities, awards, contracts, contacts and intent documents into authority-level views used for account planning.

supplierEntityInvestment.detail: Supplier and competitor relationships are joined across awards and buyers, although public documentation does not disclose identity-resolution error rates or group-company treatment.

renewalSignalMethod.detail: Expiring-contract records expose prior contract context and dates as sales signals. They are planning indicators rather than confirmed re-procurements.

requirementsPlanningMethod.detail: Bid Studio supports qualification, projects and answer reuse, but public material does not establish one durable pre-tender readiness model joining every gap, evidence item, owner and deadline.

historicalAndAwardDepth.detail: The data page publishes more than 375,000 awards alongside contracts, frameworks, call-offs and buyer-supplier relationships.

workflowAndIntegrations.detail: Current plans combine shared sales and bid workflow with CRM integrations and data-delivery options on higher tiers.

securitySupportAndOnboarding.detail: The provider publishes GDPR, privacy and MFA material, while enterprise security, retention, recovery and support commitments require contractual confirmation.

commercialModel.detail: Free, Basic, Growth and custom tiers are published across Sales Studio and Bid Studio, plus a combined package. Conflicting legacy figures remain visible on the current pricing page.

materialLimitations.detail: Most higher-tier prices are displayed as from, so users, entitlements and implementation costs need a dated order form.
AI scores and renewal signals are decision aids; public validation metrics are not published.

contradictions.detail: The live pricing page displays current Sales Studio Basic copy at from £99/month while older sections on the same page retain £75 and £50 figures.

diligenceQuestions: Provide a dated plan matrix showing the exact alert, buyer-document, CRM, export, user and usage limits at each price.
How are buyer and supplier identities canonicalised and quality-checked across portals and corporate groups?
What percentage of the 400,000-plus buyer documents is searchable as full text, how often is it refreshed, and which document classes are excluded?
What historical accuracy does the relevance score and expiring-contract workflow achieve on customer-defined markets?
Provide the DPA, subprocessor list, retention schedule, security controls, service levels and recovery targets.

caveats: The current pricing page contains conflicting entry-price figures; use the current headline package copy only as a starting point.
The free alert price and combined full-package price cover materially different products and limits.
Public corpus and coverage counts are provider-stated and have not been independently tested by Civensa.

providers.name: Tussell

pricing.plansText: Starter, Plus and Pro are sold as annual subscriptions with no public numeric price. Early Opportunities is included in Pro and can be purchased on lower tiers. API, Salesforce and analyst services are premium add-ons.
pricing.seatDetail: Public plan comparison describes tiered access but does not publish included users or additional-seat prices.
pricing.vatDetail: VAT treatment is not publicly stated on the reviewed plan page.
pricing.trialDetail: No standardized public trial term was found on the reviewed plan page.

comparablePlans.notes: Annual subscription; numeric price not published.
Annual subscription; numeric price not published. Early Opportunities can be added.
Annual subscription; full Early Opportunities access is included. API, Salesforce and analyst services may still be add-ons.

semanticAiMatching.detail: Tussell provides filters, alerts and AI-assisted early-opportunity classification, but public pages do not establish semantic tender matching against a supplier capability profile.

buyerProfiles.detail: The platform builds connected buyer views from spend, awards, notices, contracts, contacts and relationships across the procurement cycle.

supplierProfiles.detail: Tussell deduplicates and enriches supplier and award records to support competitor, customer and market analysis.

renewalSignals.detail: The bid-team product explicitly supports upcoming-renewal exports and contract-expiry monitoring.

similarContracts.detail: Users can inspect similar contract price history, prior awards, incumbents and buyer-supplier context.

buyerDocuments.detail: Early Opportunities scans thousands of buyer minutes, strategies and pipelines and turns verified passages into searchable structured signals with source links, but public pages do not establish a complete full-text document corpus available for direct search.

buyerRequirements.detail: Tender, pre-market and early-opportunity context supports qualification, but a complete structured cross-tender requirements layer is not publicly established.

requirementsPlanning.detail: The platform supports bid or no-bid qualification and pipeline planning, but not a fully documented requirements-readiness workflow with gaps, evidence, owners and deadlines.

awardHistory.detail: Awards, values, buyers, suppliers, spend and historical relationships are central to Tussell Insight.

frameworks.detail: Tussell offers framework discovery and manually links call-offs to parent frameworks.

competitorTracking.detail: Supplier profiles, award history and buyer relationships support competitor and incumbent monitoring.

exportsApi.detail: API, Salesforce and export delivery are documented, with API and Salesforce sold as premium add-ons.

collaboration.detail: Organisation subscriptions and shared data delivery are available, but public pages do not establish a complete collaborative opportunity workflow with assignments and comments.

bidWriting.detail: Tussell explicitly states that it is not bid-management or AI bid-writing software.

explicitPortals.detail: Named in Tussell's official portal guidance.
Named in Tussell's official portal guidance.
Named in Tussell's official portal guidance.
Named in Tussell's official portal guidance.

otherCoverageClaims.claim: Tussell says its tender and early-opportunity monitoring spans more than 600 portals and the full UK procurement cycle.

deepAudit.researchSummary: Tussell is a mature UK procurement-intelligence product focused on resolved buyer, supplier, award, spend, framework, renewal and pre-procurement signals. It has strong data curation and analyst-supported early-opportunity coverage, but keeps all subscription prices behind a quote and is not a bid-writing platform.

legalAndMaturity.detail: Website terms identify Tussell Ltd, company number 09454393, providing a clear UK contracting entity and operating history.

targetCustomerAndUseCase.detail: The product is positioned for public-sector sales, bid, strategy and market-intelligence teams that need tenders, renewals, competitors and early buyer intent.

dataSourcesAndCoverageMethod.detail: Tussell states full-cycle UK procurement coverage, deduplication, enrichment and manual framework call-off linkage, plus more than 600 monitored portals.

dataIngestionAndFreshness.detail: Ongoing monitoring and human verification are described, but a current per-source refresh register, amendment latency and failed-ingestion service levels are not public.

matchingAndQualificationMethod.detail: Users filter and alert on tenders and receive AI-flagged, human-verified early signals. A semantic supplier-profile match model and public validation metrics are not established.

buyerEntityInvestment.detail: Buyer intelligence connects procurement, spend, awards, contracts, contacts and early intent into organisation-level analysis.

supplierEntityInvestment.detail: Supplier records are deduplicated and enriched for competitor, customer and market-share analysis, supported by data curation beyond raw notice display.

renewalSignalMethod.detail: Upcoming renewals and contract expiry are exposed, but public pages do not publish the exact treatment of extensions, modifications, termination or historical forecast accuracy.

requirementsPlanningMethod.detail: Qualification and pipeline planning are present, while a durable requirements, gaps, evidence, owner and deadline workflow is not publicly documented.

historicalAndAwardDepth.detail: Historical awards, spend, buyer-supplier relationships, frameworks and manually linked call-offs form the core intelligence product.

workflowAndIntegrations.detail: Exports, API and Salesforce delivery are documented, although API and Salesforce are premium add-ons and bid production is outside product scope.

securitySupportAndOnboarding.detail: Privacy and data-transparency statements are public. Contract-specific access controls, retention, recovery, certifications and support commitments need confirmation.

commercialModel.detail: Starter, Plus and Pro are annual quote-only subscriptions; Early Opportunities varies by tier, and API, Salesforce and analyst services are separate premium options.

materialLimitations.detail: No numeric price, included-user count or add-on price is publicly available, so alert and full-package affordability cannot be compared without a quote.
Early Opportunities exposes structured, source-linked signals but the public page does not establish direct search across a complete full-text buyer-document corpus.
Tussell is not a bid-management or AI bid-writing tool.

diligenceQuestions: Quote Starter, Plus and Pro separately with users, alert profiles, Early Opportunities, Frameworks Finder, API, Salesforce, onboarding and renewal uplifts itemised.
Provide the current named source register, refresh schedule, amendment handling and measured coverage gaps.
How are buyer and supplier entities resolved, and how are incorrect merges and splits audited?
Can users search full buyer documents or only extracted Early Opportunities signals, and what is the corpus retention period?
How are extensions and modifications used in renewal forecasts, and what historical accuracy is measured?

caveats: All subscription tiers require a quote, so both alert price and full-package price remain unpublished.
The more-than-600-portal claim is not accompanied by a complete current public source register.
Early Opportunities combines AI flagging with human verification but is not the same as a full searchable buyer-document library.
